correctness.rationale: Starting from the exact source inverse identity (5.10), scalar Laplace densities and spectral integral kernels produce the stated full POVM. The nonstandard rank issue is resolved by an explicit block Schur complement for K0: a rank-one term plus c times a coercive lower block. At c=0 the two exponential convolutions inhabit disjoint wedges and their spectral weights have exactly the simple-minimum kernels, uniformly positive on the complementary spectral subspaces at every interior point. The direct-integral minimality construction identifies fiber rank with joint dilation multiplicity without assuming finite dimension. The included exact matrix diagnostic passed 588 rational inverse identities in dimensions 2–5 and 24 finite spectral density rank probes; these are checks, not proof of the general theorem. The theorem excludes gamma=0 and requires isolated simple eigenvalues and cyclicity.

value.rationale: Tian explicitly poses the minimal simultaneous spectral multiplicity problem. The result settles it for the entire highly structured class of his sufficient/necessary theorem, including irreducible infinite-dimensional examples with continuous spectrum. It gives the complete direct-integral fiber dimensions and geometric measure decomposition, not just an existence criterion or a small numerical improvement. The universal critical drop from full multiplicity to two codimension-one planar wedges and one rank-one curve is a structurally meaningful invariant of the dilation.
